vectors.name: nonce_preparation_request
vectors.description: Nonce Preparation request for a new or recomputed session: SESSION_ID present (PRESENCE 0x01 then 4 bytes of 0x51), SESSION_REF absent (PRESENCE 0x00), DESCRIPTOR absent (PRESENCE 0x00), MAX_INPUTS 2 (4 bytes big-endian), DERIVATION_PATH m/86'/1'/0'/0/3 (CHILD_COUNT 5 and five 4-byte big-endian children), START 0 (4 bytes big-endian) and END 1 (PRESENCE 0x01 then 4 bytes big-endian).

vectors.name: nonce_preparation_request_with_session_ref
vectors.description: Nonce Preparation request extending a held session: SESSION_ID present (PRESENCE 0x01 then 4 bytes of 0x51), SESSION_REF present (PRESENCE 0x01 then 4 bytes of 0x52), DESCRIPTOR absent (PRESENCE 0x00), MAX_INPUTS 2 (4 bytes big-endian), DERIVATION_PATH m/86'/1'/0'/0/3, START 2 and END 3 (PRESENCE 0x01 then 4 bytes big-endian).

vectors.name: nonce_preparation_request_with_descriptor
vectors.description: Nonce Preparation request for a signer whose sessions depend on the descriptor: SESSION_ID present (PRESENCE 0x01 then 4 bytes of 0x51), SESSION_REF absent (PRESENCE 0x00), DESCRIPTOR present (PRESENCE 0x01) with DESCRIPTOR_ALIAS "main", DESCRIPTOR present (PRESENCE 0x01) as a BIP-388 wallet policy (FORM 0x02) with KEYS COUNT 2, "[00000000/86h/1h/0h]xpub" and "[11111111/86h/1h/0h]xpub", and POLICY "tr(musig(@0,@1)/**)", POR absent (PRESENCE 0x00), then MAX_INPUTS 2, DERIVATION_PATH m/86'/1'/0'/0/3, START 0 and END 1 (PRESENCE 0x01 then 4 bytes big-endian).

vectors.name: nonce_preparation_request_without_end
vectors.description: Nonce Preparation request for a single key expression: SESSION_ID present (PRESENCE 0x01 then 4 bytes of 0x51), SESSION_REF absent (PRESENCE 0x00), DESCRIPTOR absent (PRESENCE 0x00), MAX_INPUTS 2 (4 bytes big-endian), DERIVATION_PATH m/86'/1'/0'/0/3, START 3 (4 bytes big-endian) and END absent (PRESENCE 0x00), so only key expression 3 is requested.

vectors.name: nonce_preparation_request_without_session_id
vectors.description: Nonce Preparation request leaving the session id to the signer: SESSION_ID absent (PRESENCE 0x00), the signer draws one and initializes a new session, SESSION_REF absent (PRESENCE 0x00), DESCRIPTOR absent (PRESENCE 0x00), MAX_INPUTS 2 (4 bytes big-endian), DERIVATION_PATH m/86'/1'/0'/0/3, START 0 and END 1 (PRESENCE 0x01 then 4 bytes big-endian).

vectors.name: nonce_preparation_response_new_session
vectors.description: Nonce Preparation ok response from a newly initialized session, answering a request with MAX_INPUTS 2, START 0 and END 1: SESSION_ID present (PRESENCE 0x01 then 4 bytes of 0x51), SESSION_REF present (PRESENCE 0x01 then 4 bytes of 0x52), then NONCES with COUNT 4 (two key expressions times two inputs), each a 66-byte NONCE without a LENGTH prefix, ordered by key expression index then input index: expression 0 input 0 with NONCE of 0x22, expression 0 input 1 with NONCE of 0x55, expression 1 input 0 with NONCE of 0x66, and expression 1 input 1 with NONCE of 0x77.

vectors.name: nonce_preparation_response_existing_session
vectors.description: Nonce Preparation ok response from a session the signer already held, answering a request with MAX_INPUTS 2, START 2 and END 3: SESSION_ID absent (PRESENCE 0x00), SESSION_REF absent (PRESENCE 0x00), then NONCES with COUNT 4, each a 66-byte NONCE without a LENGTH prefix: expression 2 input 0 with NONCE of 0x22, expression 2 input 1 with NONCE of 0x55, expression 3 input 0 with NONCE of 0x66, and expression 3 input 1 with NONCE of 0x77.
